commits.message:
feat: implement collection_len_in_loop_condition lint

Detect len() calls on Soroban collection types (Vec, Map, Set) inside
loops when the collection is not mutated. The lint suggests binding
the length before the loop to avoid repeated metered host calls.

Closes #115
